notes: Client->server strings: UInt16 byte length, then UTF-8 bytes (unescape(encodeURIComponent)).
Server->client strings: UInt16 length, then that many bytes; the client DROPS the last byte (the length includes a trailing terminator), then UTF-8-decodes the rest.
readBitGroup: bytes are read until one has bit 0 clear; bits 1-7 of each byte carry booleans / small ints (getBool, getIntWithXBits).
Every packet starts with a UInt8 message type (opcode).
